flows.name: Browse the shop
flows.objective: Using the site's header navigation (open the Menu button first if the links are not visible), go to the Shop page. Confirm at least 3 products are listed, each with a price and an 'Add to cart' button.

flows.name: Checkout
flows.objective: Add 'Trail Runner Shoes' to the cart. Then open the cart using the site's header navigation (open the Menu button first if the links are not visible). Change its quantity to 2, press 'Place order', and confirm an 'Order confirmed' message appears.

flows.name: Newsletter signup
flows.objective: Fill in the 'Get trail notes' form with name 'Test User' and email 'test@example.com', press 'Subscribe', and confirm a 'You're subscribed' message appears.
